pages.title: Free nationwide HPV vaccination for adolescent girls

facts.text: Union Health Ministry — HPV vaccination for girls aged 14; voluntary and free
facts.head: Programme

facts.text: Vaccine: Gardasil (quadrivalent) — HPV 16 & 18 (cervical cancer) + HPV 6 & 11 (warts); single-dose (optional second dose after 3–5 years)
facts.head: Programme

facts.text: Procured via Gavi, the Vaccine Alliance; ⚠ indigenous Cervavac not yet WHO-approved for programme
facts.head: Programme

facts.text: Based on NTAGI recommendation; only at government facilities (Ayushman Arogya Mandirs, CHCs, hospitals, medical colleges); tracked on U-WIN
facts.head: Programme

facts.text: Safety/efficacy: 500 million+ doses since 2006; 93–100% effective; non-live vaccine
facts.head: Programme

facts.text: Cervical cancer — 2nd most common cancer among Indian women; ~80,000 cases, 42,000+ deaths a year; HPV 16/18 cause >80%
facts.head: Burden

facts.text: ⚠ Vaccine does not replace screening — Pap smear from 21 years; HPV DNA test after 30
facts.head: Burden

facts.text: WHO 90–70–90 targets by 2030 (WHA 73.2): 90% girls vaccinated by 15; 70% women screened (35 and 45); 90% treated
facts.head: Burden

facts.text: 90+ countries use single-dose HPV schedule
facts.head: Burden

facts.text: Mission Indradhanush — immunisation of children and pregnant women
facts.head: Burden
